implementation: Cisco Aironet LWAPP AP1131AG and Cisco Aironet AP1242AG
description: The Cisco LWAPP Aironet 1131, 1242 access points deliver the versatility, high capacity, security, and enterprise-class features required for small, medium and large Government deployments. In FIPS 140-2 mode of operation, the Cisco APs support the IEEE 802.11i and IEEE 802.1x standards and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) for WPA2 encryption.
